evals.prompt: Create a new blog post about my experience with AI coding tools. Title: 'AI Coding Tools Comparison', description: 'Comparing different AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot', categories: ['AI', 'Tools', 'Programming'], tags: ['AI', 'Claude Code', 'Codex', 'GitHub Copilot', 'Comparison']
evals.expected_output: Creates a folder content/post/0401-ai-coding-tools-comparison/ with cover.png and index.md containing proper frontmatter and initial content
expectations: Copies static/cover.png to post folder as cover.png
Creates index.md with correct TOML frontmatter including date, draft=true, title, description, categories, tags, and image fields
Frontmatter uses single quotes for string values
Initial content includes the provided description and section headers
Folder name follows MMDD-title-slug pattern with current date

evals.expected_output: Creates a folder content/post/0401-2026-week-15-tech-updates/ with cover.png and index.md containing proper frontmatter and initial content
expectations: Copies static/cover.png to post folder as cover.png
Creates index.md with correct TOML frontmatter

Folder name contains correct date prefix and slugified title
